text.tspan: Bavaria's wine region; bone-dry Silvaner in a distinctive Bocksbeutel bottle from Muschelkalk
Only German wine region in Bavaria; uniquely positioned in Franconian cultural identity
Bone-dry Silvaner from Muschelkalk soils defines an earthy, mineral style unlike anywhere else
Bocksbeutel bottle is legally protected; instantly recognizable; defines Franken identity
Yes; ~20% steep slopes, up to 65% gradient
Bone-dry; Trocken is the regional norm;
Majority small growers; 3500+ growers, 500 wineries, 5 cooperatives
Berg (Bürgstadter Centgrafenberg) was Germany's first PDO; Stein vineyard oldest
Bone-dry style: Franken driest of all German wine regions; Trocken is cultural
Franken is in Bayern (Bavaria) — only German wine region in this state
Bocksbeutel protected to Franken and Zell im Ortenau (Baden) — not only Franken
Silvaner ~25% but declining; some Spaetburgunder from Churfranken is world class
Main river moderates heat; forests give wind shelter
